# Session traces

Every LLM session in this repo is published here: what was asked, what the agent did, what it cost in tokens, and which commits came out of it.
This page adds up all the sessions. Each session's folder has a readable `summary.md`, the detailed `manifest.json`, and links to the full redacted log. A session that ran in a loop of `llm-dlc/tools/feature-loop.sh` also has a `runs/` folder: the loop's record of each run, redacted (the instruction, a line per commit, and how the run ended), which its summary lists under *Loop runs*.
[Loop statistics](loops.md) adds up the loops themselves: time, tokens and cost by category, loop, run, cycle and item.
The [procedure](../README.md#procedure-for-agents) says how traces are made, and the [specification](../specification.md) defines them.

## Session notes

Corrections and context, written by hand, for what a session's log and commits cannot say.

- [`01a1f5be`](../session-notes/01a1f5be-43bd-7532-a80c-5b4f5c304590.md): The change `qsopuqyv` and the five-task follow-up job describe five receipt-schema refusals. The first finite-word batch actually recorded **four refusals**. All five checkers returned. The four property receipts stopped at validation of the solver counters. The same-day equivalence published an established receipt in that batch and again in its linked retry. [First batch](../../verification/results/20261120-010828-retry-all-five-full-grid-threetenbp-regi/result.json) · [All five published results](../../verification/results/20261120-012520-publish-five-linked-full-grid-threetenbp/result.json)
- [`560d5e98`](../session-notes/560d5e98-2825-4bc2-90e2-39953d65d9c0.md): This session also did work that is not in this repo, and one entry under its *Changes* is not its own.

## Reading these numbers

- All figures come from the manifests in this folder, so they can be rebuilt from the repo. There are no dollar costs, because a manifest does not record what any call was billed.
- An open session is still growing. Its figures here run ahead of its uploaded logs until the next push.
- A session is one Claude Code conversation, including everything after a compaction. It can cover unrelated work, and the work need not be in this repo.
- Commit totals count each commit once, so they can be lower than the sum of the sessions' commit counts.
